messages.subject: Problem Ingestion in NicheMapR 3.0
parts:
Hi all, 
I noticed that Ingestion predictions (var. GDRYFOOD) from the DEB model of NicheMapR 3.0 does not seem to be correct anymore (at least in my simulations). I used to obtain realistic values in v. 2.0 but not anymore. 

For instance, in my simulation a fish grow 300g over a period, and only ingest 3g in total (unless the unit changed ?). 

I believe that this is related to the change between F_m parameters and p.Xm as argument of the rundeb function. 

Would you have any suggestion about this problem ? 
All the best, 

Killian
